ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Venus at {H:1820171153000}

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between the Moon and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Venus brings affection and harmony. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.
